info.title: Nyaya API
info.description: Single write path for the Flutter app and the Content Management Portal. Errors use { code, message, details, request_id }. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.

expires_at.description: Answers are refused after this; submitting is still allowed

latest.description: The newest version, which is the one actions apply to

correct_option_ids.description: Never sent to learners before they answer
Never sent to learners before they answer

change_note.description: Why the published question is changing

mode.description: case_path: one level (one subject, one difficulty). daily_docket: today's set, the same for everyone, once a day. duel: practice against the clock. exam: answers revealed at the end. mistake_review: your own wrong answers, free. Decides feedback and rewards.

negative_marking.description: Exam only: take 0.25 off for each wrong answer

difficulty.description: Only this difficulty; any when omitted

question_id.description: The question (all versions), for saving it

options.description: In the order to show them

feedback.description: Only after this question is answered (immediate mode) or the session is submitted

mode_multiplier.description: 1.25 for the docket, 0.5 for replaying a 3-star level, else 1

energy_bonus.description: Energy given back for a first 3-star clear

best_stars_before.description: Best stars on this level before this session

new_stars.description: Stars added to the level best

streak_extended.description: True when this was today's first finished quiz

current.description: Current streak today; 0 once it has lapsed

active_days.description: Days with a finished quiz, last 21, India dates

frozen_days.description: Missed days a freeze covered, last 21

best.description: Best score as a fraction of the session total, 0–1

today.description: India date the figures are for

settings.description: Null until the learner saves settings once

last_week.description: Last week, for closing the league

stars.description: Best Case Path stars per level id

me.description: This row is the signed-in learner

practice.description: A simulated player topping up a small group

bonus_coins.description: Coins for finishing in the top 3

joined.description: Joined this week's league (with a quiz)

last_result.description: How the latest finished week ended

available.description: False when retired or no longer in force

updated_since.description: The question was revised after the learner answered it; this is the version they answered

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first, ending with the learner's question (at most 20 turns)

stem.description: Question text of the reported version

urgent.description: Wrong answer and outdated law are legal errors: handle first

outcome.description: fixed: the question was revised; retired: taken out; no_change: the question is right
